data.narrative:
Terraform Industries is a Series A climate & energy company that has raised $26M to date. The comparable universe for this stage and sector comprises nine peer companies—one public (Lnza) and eight private firms including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen—though none offer sufficient overlap in stage and valuation tier to support a reliable peer-median multiple approach.

Given the limited peer dataset, stage-progression methodology provides the most defensible anchor. Using total capital raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement yields an implied valuation of $52M. This method reflects the capital intensity and development timeline characteristic of frontier-energy ventures at this stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $44M to $60M, with a median of $52M. Key uncertainties center on the absence of tightly comparable same-stage private transactions in Climate & Energy; the single applicable method limits triangulation robustness. Near-term clarity on technical validation, capital efficiency, and path to revenue would strengthen confidence in this range. Future fundraising activity within the identified peer set may provide better calibration points for narrower banding.
